title: AIIMS Rajkot Jobs 2026 - Apply Online for Technical Officer Posts
description: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rajkot (AIIMS Rajkot) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 01 Technical Officer post. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their MBBS or BDS can apply for the AIIMS Rajkot Jobs 2026. Interested applicants can apply in online mode. Here we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection process, ...
